ABOUT THIS VEHICLE

Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami is delighted to offer this 2025 Lamborghini Urus SE for sale!

Representing a new chapter for Lamborghinis high-performance SUV, the Urus SE combines a twin-turbocharged 4.0L V8 with an electric motor to produce an astonishing 789 horsepower and 701 lb-ft of combined torque. With standard all-wheel drive and an 8-speed automatic transmission, the Urus SE can accelerate from 0–62 mph in just 3.4 seconds and reach a top speed of 194 mph, delivering supercar-level performance from behind the wheel of a luxury SUV. Its sculpted bodywork, aggressive front and rear design, distinctive lighting, and commanding stance give the Urus SE an unmistakable Lamborghini presence whether cruising through Miami or arriving at an exclusive destination. Inside, the cabin blends Italian craftsmanship, premium materials, advanced technology, and a driver-focused layout with the space and versatility expected from a modern SUV. The plug-in hybrid system also allows the Urus SE to travel in full-electric mode for more than 60 kilometers under Lamborghinis stated testing conditions, adding an entirely new dimension to its everyday usability. For those seeking the extraordinary combination of Lamborghini performance, luxury, versatility, and cutting-edge electrification, the 2025 Urus SE stands in a class of its own.

Contact Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami to make this Urus SE yours today. Sales Price includes dealer fee of $1447.50 and $299 electronic filing fee. Tax, tag, title and registrations fees are not included and are calculated at time of purchase.
